summary.text: Denise Slipy is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Keri Heintzeman (R).
Ballotpedia lists her profession as consultant.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Denise Slipy said she is running to represent rural Minnesota, where she said affordability, health care access and school funding are concerns.
She said she supports health care for all, fully funded public education, and careers in the trades with strong union jobs.
